headline: Retail Earnings Season Could Be the Messiest Yet
summary: Retail earnings season kicks off Aug. 19 with investors expected to focus less on tariff-driven margin gains and more on whether companies such as Walmart, Target, Dollar General, and Five Below can sustain sales growth.
